uart.signal: real firmware (firmware-f401-demo, link-compatible reuse) boots on the stm32f767 descriptor and its USART2 output matches the uart_contains 'OK' oracle; run 2026-08-05, exit 0
uart.lane: manual example run (examples/nucleo-f767zi) - not yet CI-wired
uart.note: evidence covers the F4-profile shared IP the F767 reuses; F7-only peripherals (Ethernet/LTDC/CAN/USB/SAI/QSPI) are not declared in the chip yaml

spi.gap: no fixture loads configs/chips/stm32f767.yaml and moves SPI bytes; the descriptor reuses the F4 spi model but evidence does not transfer automatically - a nucleo-f767zi SPI fixture is follow-up work

i2c.gap: no fixture loads configs/chips/stm32f767.yaml and completes an I2C transaction; the F7 i2c instances run the stm32l4 (v2) profile, which IS proven on stm32l476, but per-chip evidence does not transfer - a nucleo-f767zi I2C fixture is follow-up work
